title: Fourier-to-binary coefficients
statement: For a function $p$ on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, define a real coefficient for each subset $T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ as one half of the difference between the indicator that $T$ is empty and the Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $T$.
